passive.name: Frost Shot
passive.description: Ashe's attacks slow their target, causing her to deal increased damage to these targets. Ashe's critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow to the target.

spells.name: Ranger's Focus
spells.description: Passive: Ashe's Attacks grant a stack for seconds. At stacks, she may activate this Ability. Active: Ashe gains % Attack Speed and her Attacks deal damage instead for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation EmpoweredDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Volley
spells.description: Ashe fires a volley of arrows, each dealing physical damage. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows, but only take damage from the first.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Hawkshot
spells.description: Ashe sends forth a hawk to grant vision for 5 seconds anywhere on the map. It also reveals the area around it as it flies. This Ability has 2 charges ( second recharge).
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
spells.description: Ashe launches a crystal arrow of ice that Stuns the first champion hit and deals magic damage. The Stun duration increases with distance travelled, up to seconds. Surrounding enemies are Slowed by Frost Shot.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation RMainDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
